nodes.description: In the two older of three siblings homozygous for P364L, chronic hepatitis with portal fibrosis (with sclerosing cholangitis in one), autoimmune enteritis with villous atrophy, inflammatory lung disease and T cell and plasma cell skin infiltrates progressed through the second decade. The youngest sibling, aged 4, has had only one severe infection so far. The resected lung lobe also grew Mycobacterium tuberculosis, and the authors describe the lung lesion as an exaggerated inflammatory response rather than calling it autoimmune. Organ autoimmunity has not been reported in the complete-deficiency patients or in P2, whose autoimmunity is limited to anti-type I IFN autoantibodies.
